pt_post_mnf_sunday_changepoint.classification_evidence: Two-sided by construction (no direction was predeclared), so wrong_sign_resolved is inadmissible under any result. No positive control has been shown able to resolve a break of this size on this construct, so positive_control_bound is inadmissible. Category 3 by AGENTS.md.
pt_post_mnf_sunday_changepoint.description: Free-break single-changepoint diagnostic on the pt_post_mnf_sunday construct (team-game rows, own prior REG game this season was a Monday, current game Sunday; flag and eligible population imported verbatim from scripts/primetime_cells_screen.py; REG 2009-2025). Effect = post-break mean minus pre-break mean of the per-season full-slate-scaled effect series at the data-located break, using scripts/era_magnitude_profile.py Stage-2a changepoint machinery. Structural/diagnostic cell with NO predeclared direction.
pt_post_mnf_sunday_changepoint.notes: Predeclared in docs/era_mechanism_screens_20260901.md section 2.2 BEFORE any effect was computed; proposed unrun in docs/era_magnitude_report.md section 2.2. Located break season 2019 (bootstrap median 2019, 95 percent spread [2012, 2023]); pre-break mean +0.2550 [-0.1324, +0.6470] P+=0.8997, post-break mean -0.1874 [-0.6335, +0.2624] P+=0.2084. The batterys FIXED 2017/2018 convention on the same series gives pre +0.2557 / post -0.1329, gap -0.3886 [-0.9786, +0.2046] P+=0.0969 - the fixed convention and the free break agree to within 0.05 points, so the fixed boundary was not in the wrong place. Within-week permutation null (200 draws): the free-break magnitude null is centred near zero (-0.0157) with spread [-1.0283, +1.0267] and 65.5 percent of null draws have |magnitude| at or above the observed |0.4424| - an optimal changepoint estimator manufactures a break this large from a shuffled label most of the time; the fixed-convention gap fares better (21.5 percent). SEASON-BLOCKED SECONDARY IS STRUCTURALLY DEGENERATE for this metric and carries no information: a season-block resample of a per-season-series statistic reproduces the same series every draw, collapsing the interval to a point - reported for completeness only. DISCLOSED OVERLAP: same rows as pt_post_mnf_sunday and its two era arms; correlated, never an independent vote. Mined-window discount applies. n_flag 586 of 8090 eligible.
pt_post_mnf_sunday_changepoint.plain_summary: A team playing Sunday six days after its own Monday night game used to beat the spread slightly and now does slightly worse. This asks whether the data itself picks out a year when that changed. It picks 2019, but a shuffled version of the same data picks a break almost as big two thirds of the time, so the break is not distinguishable from noise.
